description: 기간 내 명의인 계좌에서 입금 또는 출금 거래가 1건 이상 발생한 고객 수
sql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT cust.cust_no) AS value 
FROM cust JOIN acct_rel ON acct_rel.cust_no = cust.cust_no AND acct_rel.rel_cd = '01' JOIN acct ON acct.acct_no = acct_rel.acct_no JOIN txn ON txn.acct_no = acct.acct_no 
WHERE txn.txn_cd IN ('IN', 'OUT') AND txn.txn_dt BETWEEN '20260701' AND '20260930' AND txn.cncl_yn = 'N'
